2026-11-05.headline: Teams will organize muted and meeting chats into dedicated sections in January
2026-11-05.overview: Microsoft Teams will introduce a January 2027 chat reorganization: the Muted chats section will be enabled by default, while Meeting chats will be disabled by default, with users able to toggle and reorder both. Two worldwide changes are also planned for December 2026: a Workflows template that links team tags to channel membership and mobile call declines with chat messages. Documentation updates add certified-device entries and SlimCore troubleshooting detail.
2026-11-05.adminImpact: No required tenant-wide action is stated for the chat sections or mobile call-message feature. The Workflows template is optional and does not change defaults. Administrators should review the updated certified-hardware table during inventory and deployment planning; VDI support teams can use the specified BITS Client and AppXDeployment-Server logs when investigating SlimCore error 6/51.

keyChanges.title: Muted and meeting chats get dedicated sections in January 2027
keyChanges.detail: Teams will add Muted chats and Meeting chats sections. Muted chats will be enabled by default, while Meeting chats will be disabled by default. Users can enable or disable and reorder the sections, and muted chats move automatically unless they are favorited. Rollout begins in January 2027, with no admin action required.

keyChanges.title: Workflows will connect team tags to channel membership
keyChanges.detail: An optional Workflows app template will automatically add users to channels when they are added to a team tag. The feature rolls out worldwide in mid-December 2026 and does not change defaults.

keyChanges.title: Teams mobile users will be able to decline calls with messages
keyChanges.detail: Users will be able to decline incoming Teams mobile calls with a predefined or custom message sent through Teams chat. Worldwide rollout is scheduled for December 2026; the feature applies only to Teams-to-Teams calls with available chat and requires no admin action.

keyChanges.title: Certified Hardware Android adds Meeting Owl and Cisco entries
keyChanges.detail: The table now includes Meeting Owl 5 Pro, Owl Tablet, and multiple Cisco devices, along with their associated software versions and certification dates. Administrators can use these details when validating inventories and planning deployments.

keyChanges.title: SlimCore troubleshooting adds Windows error 6/51 guidance
keyChanges.detail: Vdi 2 Troubleshooting now documents Windows error 6/51, ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE, during SlimCore download, deployment, or startup, and points administrators to BITS Client and AppXDeployment-Server logs.

2026-11-06.headline: Teams Rooms app update tool is no longer recommended for new Autopilot deployments
2026-11-06.overview: This was a quiet, documentation-led day with one actionable Teams Rooms change. The Autopilot guidance says the Teams Rooms app has included automatic updates since April 2024, so the app update tool is no longer recommended for new deployments. A separate known-issues entry records possible Large Gallery unavailability on specified Teams Rooms for Android versions, while release notes document a low-bitrate video fix. Teams Phone updates only reorder language entries in reference and setup material.
2026-11-06.adminImpact: Review Intune assignments for the app update tool and consider unassigning it for new deployments, except when deploying devices older than 2025. Administrators should expect possible Large Gallery unavailability on the affected Android app versions; no action is specified for that issue or the low-bitrate video fix. The Teams Phone language-order changes require no configuration change.

keyChanges.title: Autopilot guidance changes the app update tool recommendation
keyChanges.detail: Because the Teams Rooms app has included automatic updates since April 2024, the app update tool is no longer recommended for new deployments. Administrators should review Intune configurations and consider unassigning the tool, except when deploying devices older than 2025.

keyChanges.title: Large Gallery may be unavailable on specified Teams Rooms for Android versions
keyChanges.detail: The known-issues page identifies possible Large Gallery unavailability on Teams Rooms for Android app versions 1449/1.0.96.2026249711 through 1449/1.0.96.2026264504. The issue is expected to be addressed in a future update, and no administrator action is specified.

keyChanges.title: Release notes record a low-bitrate video fix
keyChanges.detail: Teams Rooms release notes now document a fix for certain devices sending low-bitrate video in specific meeting scenarios. The supplied evidence states no administrator action.

2026-11-07.headline: Teams guidance shifts from webinar and town hall names to audience-based event labels
2026-11-07.overview: The period is dominated by terminology and procedure updates rather than product rollouts. Updated event guidance now uses “Events up to 1k attendees” and “Events optimized for a large audience” across recording, attendance, setup, captions, publishing, and chat topics. A separate Teams Rooms update revises screenshots and the note-saving workflow.
2026-11-07.adminImpact: Update administrator runbooks, training, and troubleshooting references to the audience-based event labels and the renamed “Events registration form questions” setting. The setup guidance says associated policy names and commands remain the same, transcription settings remain On by default, and the Teams Rooms update states that no administrator configuration change is required.

keyChanges.title: Policy references adopt audience-based event labels
keyChanges.detail: The Settings Policies Reference now uses “Events up to 1k attendees” and “Events optimized for a large audience” instead of webinar and town hall terminology across related settings. Use the revised labels when locating policy controls.

keyChanges.title: Recording guidance documents separate audience-size event settings
keyChanges.detail: The Meeting Recording article now groups webinars and town halls under events and documents settings for events with up to 1,000 attendees or for large audiences. It also clarifies policy-assignment instructions.

keyChanges.title: Anonymous-attendance instructions use the new event names
keyChanges.detail: The guide replaces “Who can attend webinars” and “Who can attend town halls” with “Who can attend events up to 1k attendees” and “Who can attend events optimized for a large audience,” and updates the configuration steps for anonymous participants.

keyChanges.title: Event registration setting receives a new documented name
keyChanges.detail: The setting formerly documented as “Webinar registration form questions” is now called “Events registration form questions.” Administrators should update internal configuration references and runbooks that use the previous name.

keyChanges.title: Teams Rooms note-saving workflow and visuals are revised
keyChanges.detail: The Facilitator Teams Rooms article updates screenshots, preview wording, and instructions for adding participant names when saving notes so participants can access notes and transcripts later. The revised workflow is useful for user guidance, with no administrator configuration change stated.

2026-11-09.headline: SIP Gateway plan drops Edge V 200+ firmware 8.5.1.0565 listing
2026-11-09.overview: The Devices update removes the Edge V 200+ entry with firmware version 8.5.1.0565 from the SIP Gateway plan’s IP Phone section.
2026-11-09.adminImpact: Administrators validating device and firmware support should review the updated SIP Gateway plan.

keyChanges.title: Edge V 200+ entry removed from the SIP Gateway plan
keyChanges.detail: The plan page no longer lists Edge V 200+ with firmware version 8.5.1.0565 under IP Phone. Use the revised plan when checking device and firmware support.

2026-11-10.headline: Teams will retire off-network invitations for Teams Free accounts in December
2026-11-10.overview: Starting December 2026, external people will no longer be able to create Teams Free accounts through email invitations or chat links. Existing Teams Free collaboration and federation remain unchanged. The period also updates Teams guidance on external-call limits and Teams Rooms deployment and feature references.
2026-11-10.adminImpact: Update user guidance before December 2026; no tenant configuration change is specified. Administrators should also note that external 1:1 calling may be temporarily restricted when documented limits are reached, with limits potentially influenced by tenant age and calling activity. The Teams Rooms changes provide deployment and feature-review references rather than new administrative requirements.

keyChanges.title: Off-network Teams Free invitations are retiring
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft will retire off-network invitations starting December 2026. Users will no longer be able to invite external people by email or chat link to create Teams Free accounts, while existing Teams Free collaboration and federation continue unchanged.

keyChanges.title: Teams limits guidance now covers temporary external-call restrictions
keyChanges.detail: The limits documentation now says limits may depend on factors including tenant age and calling activity. When a limit is reached, users may be temporarily unable to place outbound 1:1 calls to external users.

keyChanges.title: Teams Rooms Facilitator guidance adds dedicated front-of-room screenshots
keyChanges.detail: The page now uses separate screenshots for the notes panel and Facilitator messages in the chat panel on the front-of-room display, giving administrators clearer visual reference when reviewing these features.

keyChanges.title: Teams Rooms Autopilot guidance names version 5.0.111.0
keyChanges.detail: The documentation now identifies version 5.0.111.0 alongside the automatic update functionality included since April 2024, adding a specific version reference for deployment reviews.

2026-11-02.headline: Teams will add muted and meeting chat sections in January 2027
2026-11-02.overview: Teams’ most consequential update this week is a planned January 2027 chat reorganization: users will get separate Muted chats and Meeting chats sections. The period also brings an optional tag-driven channel workflow, a broad shift in event-policy terminology, and two Teams Rooms administration issues: the app update tool is no longer recommended for new deployments, and Large Gallery may be unavailable on a defined Android app range.
2026-11-02.adminImpact: Chat sections require no admin action. The tag workflow is optional and does not change defaults, so admins can assess it for location- or project-based groups rather than prepare a tenant-wide change. For Teams Rooms, review Intune assignments for the app update tool: the guidance says automatic app updates have been included since April 2024 and suggests considering unassignment except for devices older than 2025. Update event runbooks and policy references to the labels “Events up to 1k attendees” and “Events optimized for a large audience.” On affected Android Rooms versions, expect Large Gallery to be unavailable.

keyChanges.title: New sections will organize muted and meeting chats
keyChanges.detail: Teams will introduce Muted chats, enabled by default, and Meeting chats, disabled by default, beginning in January 2027. Users can enable, disable, and reorder the sections; muted chats move automatically into their section unless they are favorited.

keyChanges.title: A Workflows template will sync team tags with channels
keyChanges.detail: An optional Workflows app template will automatically add users to channels when they are added to a team tag. Worldwide rollout is scheduled for mid-December 2026, with no default changes, supporting location- or project-based groups.

keyChanges.title: Event policy references now use attendee-capacity labels
keyChanges.detail: The Settings Policies Reference now uses “Events up to 1k attendees” and “Events optimized for a large audience” instead of webinar and town hall terminology across related settings.

keyChanges.title: Teams Rooms guidance no longer recommends the app update tool for new deployments
keyChanges.detail: The Autopilot Autologin guidance says Teams Rooms app automatic updates have been included since April 2024, so the app update tool is no longer recommended for new deployments. It advises reviewing Intune assignments and considering unassignment except when deploying devices older than 2025.

keyChanges.title: Large Gallery may be unavailable on specific Android Rooms builds
keyChanges.detail: The known-issues page identifies a limitation on Teams Rooms for Android app versions 1449/1.0.96.2026249711 through 1449/1.0.96.2026264504. Administrators should expect Large Gallery to be unavailable on those builds while awaiting a future update.

2026-11-09.headline: Teams Free off-network invitations retire in December 2026
2026-11-09.overview: The period’s consequential change is a Teams Free restriction: starting in December 2026, users will no longer be able to invite people outside the network by email or chat link to create Teams Free accounts. Existing Teams Free collaboration and federation remain unchanged. The other updates are documentation changes, including clearer external-calling limits guidance and Teams Rooms and SIP Gateway reference edits.
2026-11-09.adminImpact: Update user guidance to remove or revise the off-network Teams Free invitation path; Microsoft says no administrator action is required. Make support teams aware that tenant age and calling activity can contribute to temporary restrictions on outbound 1:1 calls to external users. Review the revised SIP Gateway plan when validating device and firmware support; the Teams Rooms documentation edits require no specified action.

keyChanges.title: Teams Free will retire off-network invitations in December 2026
keyChanges.detail: Users will no longer be able to invite external people by email or chat link to create Teams Free accounts. Existing Teams Free collaboration and federation remain unchanged.

keyChanges.title: Teams limits guidance documents temporary external 1:1 calling restrictions
keyChanges.detail: The limits page now states that limits may depend on factors including tenant age and calling activity. When a limit is reached, users may be temporarily unable to place outbound 1:1 calls to external users.

keyChanges.title: SIP Gateway plan removes an Edge V 200+ firmware entry
keyChanges.detail: The plan page no longer lists Edge V 200+ with firmware version 8.5.1.0565 under IP Phone. Administrators validating device and firmware support should use the updated plan.

keyChanges.title: Facilitator Teams Rooms guidance adds dedicated front-of-room screenshots
keyChanges.detail: The documentation now uses separate screenshots for the notes panel and Facilitator messages in the chat panel on the front-of-room display, improving visual deployment and review guidance.

keyChanges.title: Autopilot Autologin guidance adds version 5.0.111.0
keyChanges.detail: The page now identifies version 5.0.111.0 alongside the automatic update functionality included since April 2024, giving administrators an additional deployment reference.

2026-11.headline: Teams Free off-network invitations retire in December as chat sections arrive in January
2026-11.overview: November’s clearest user-facing deadline is Teams Free’s December 2026 retirement of off-network invitations: email and chat-link invites will no longer create Teams Free accounts, while existing collaboration and federation remain unchanged. Teams will also begin rolling out Muted chats and Meeting chats in January 2027, alongside an optional Workflows template for tag-driven channel membership. Documentation updates mainly standardize event terminology and revise Teams Rooms deployment guidance.
2026-11.adminImpact: Update user guidance for the retired Teams Free invitation route; Microsoft says no administrator action is required. No tenant change is needed for the new chat sections, and the tag workflow is optional with no default changes. Update event runbooks to use “Events up to 1k attendees” and “Events optimized for a large audience”; the associated policy names and commands remain the same. Review Intune assignments for the Teams Rooms app update tool and consider unassigning it for new deployments, with the documented exception for devices older than 2025. Also expect Large Gallery to be unavailable on affected Teams Rooms for Android app versions 1449/1.0.96.2026249711 through 1449/1.0.96.2026264504.

keyChanges.title: Teams Free will stop accepting off-network invitations
keyChanges.detail: Starting in December 2026, users will no longer be able to invite external people by email or chat link to create Teams Free accounts. Existing Teams Free collaboration and federation remain unchanged.

keyChanges.title: Teams adds separate Muted chats and Meeting chats sections
keyChanges.detail: The January 2027 rollout adds Muted chats, enabled by default, and Meeting chats, disabled by default. Users can enable, disable, and reorder the sections; muted chats move automatically unless they are favorited.

keyChanges.title: A Workflows template will add tag members to channels automatically
keyChanges.detail: Rolling out worldwide in mid-December 2026, the optional template adds users to channels when they are added to a team tag. It is aimed at location- or project-based groups and does not change defaults.

keyChanges.title: Event guidance adopts attendee-size labels across policy instructions
keyChanges.detail: Setup and policy documentation now uses “Events up to 1k attendees” and “Events optimized for a large audience” instead of webinar and town hall labels. The associated policy names and commands remain the same.

keyChanges.title: Teams Rooms guidance drops the app update tool for new deployments
keyChanges.detail: The documentation says the Teams Rooms app has included automatic updates since April 2024, so the app update tool is no longer recommended for new deployments. It advises reviewing Intune configurations and considering unassignment except for devices older than 2025.
